name: dev-learn-workspace
description: DevLearn Platform: Unified Workspace (API + Cross-platform Mobile & Web App)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix api && npm install --prefix mobile-app
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "API,APP" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run web --prefix mobile-app"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --names "API,APP" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run web --prefix mobile-app"
scripts.dev:all:tunnel: concurrently --names "API,APP" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run tunnel:web --prefix mobile-app"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently --names "API,APP" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run tunnel --prefix mobile-app"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build:web && NODE_ENV=production node api/server.js
